title: Tennessee Code Title 8, Chapters 34-37 - Tennessee Consolidated Retirement System
verified_how: expanded the register's table of contents: 'Title 8 Public Officers And Employees' lists 'Chapter 34 Retirement - Generally', 'Chapter 35 Retirement - Membership', 'Chapter 36 Retirement Benefits' and 'Chapter 37 Retirement - Financing and Funds' as four consecutive unmarked chapters, alongside 'Chapter 38 Social Security', 'Chapter 39 Miscellaneous Pensions and Retirement Funds' and an 'APPENDIX Superseded Retirement Systems'; the TOC does print markers in this Title ('Chapters 28, 29 [Reserved]', 'Chapter 32 [Reserved]', 'Chapters 40, 41 [Reserved]'), so their absence on chs. 34-37 is informative. No section text was opened; no currency date is published on the table of contents.
notes: TCRS, cited as title 8, chapters 34-37 taken together - that is how Tennessee cites the scheme, and splitting it would misdescribe it. Chapter 38 (Social Security) only brings Tennessee public employees under the federal scheme; old-age, survivors and disability insurance itself is federal (Social Security Act, 42 U.S.C. ch. 7). Private pension plans are touched by title 50, ch. 1, pt. 4 (Private Pensions and Retirement Plans) but are substantively governed by federal ERISA, 29 U.S.C. ch. 18. See the in_force caveat under Payroll/wages.
